relationship_reviews.finding: Same credited photographer Dinesh Valke, but distinct reported dates (2015, 2008, 2009) and inspected compositions. Only tg-0002 fits visually. No shared capture asserted from the generic titles.
Same creator Tim Kiser, same Lewisville park, 2023-02-11 at 12:18:56 and 12:37:22: related outing risk. Only tg-0054 fits visually; tg-0053 is rejected, so both are not included.
Same creator Karthick and same wall visible, 2016-06-30 at 19:00:59 and 19:01:27. Both rejected visually; no paired views enter the contribution.

Both initially fit visually. Full previews show a similar distinctive leaning fig sheath with elongated openings and a hanging root bundle; both identify Everglades National Park, in 2007 and 2021. Probable shared subject, not proven. Conservatively exclude tg-0125 and retain tg-0117; see relationship-exclusions.json.

Root photographs received additional source review. tg-0104 identifies Tuolumne Grove (2011); tg-0107 identifies Grant Grove (2024), with different visible roots. tg-0106 is visually rejected. tg-0109 has unknown location/capture date and public-domain source credit; no specific relationship was established by the inspected preview or metadata. Unknown context is retained as a limitation.

Both credit Dinesh Valke; dates 2015-02-01 and 2008-01-26, with distinct thick liana and fine Cassytha growth in the inspected previews. No shared capture identified. Creator reuse itself is not a TG01 exclusion.
Metadata identifies Ta Prohm in Cambodia, Valparai in India, and Bandhavgarh in India respectively. Inspected structures differ. No common physical tree or capture identified.

limitations: No exhaustive upstream capture/series investigation or independent rights authentication. Commons statements, known relationships and explicit doubts are preserved. Distinct dates, titles, creators and hashes do not certify independence. tg-0109 has no reported license URL, location or capture date.
